items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Poor Sam Morgan, he's dead and gone. He's the one who started that, toying that marsh. And now they play that for a dance. When the saints come marching by, Sam Morgan made that up and toying that up, you know, to a jazz piece, to dance.

ctx.x: Your husband was from that same neighborhood?

No, he was from around here. Not around here, but around... Around... Around... Prairie Street. Around... Around Caloret, Laperouse. And then when he was small and his mother was living and all, they lived back Olyan and... Olyan and... Olyan and... Olyan and... Russia Blade. Olyan and Russia Blade, yeah. They lived around there. But he'd come up right in the... He'd come up after that, when the time he started the band and all that, right there in the Tramie. You know, right in the Tramie. That was the best part…
